title: Applicability.
bodyText: This chapter applies to a transfer on death deed executed at any time by a transferor who dies on or after July 1, 2011.
bodyHtml: [§527‑3]  Applicability.  This chapter applies to a transfer on death deed executed at any time by a transferor who dies on or after July 1, 2011. [L 2011, c 173, pt of §1]
